nodes.label: Cross-document view transitions
nodes.rationale: The feature: browser snapshots the old page, navigates, then animates from the old snapshot to the new page; render blocking keeps the new page stable before the transition animates.

nodes.label: @view-transition at-rule
nodes.rationale: Opt in on both pages via @view-transition { navigation: auto }; disable under prefers-reduced-motion with @view-transition { navigation: none }.

nodes.label: blocking="render" attribute
nodes.rationale: On critical head resources: the browser waits for them (up to ~4s) before animating the transition; do NOT block on non-critical content.

nodes.label: <link rel="expect"> element
nodes.rationale: Blocks rendering until the target DOM element (href fragment id) is parsed; prevents transitions animating to a blank or partially rendered page.

nodes.label: view-transition-name
nodes.rationale: Names elements that morph between old and new pages (e.g., view-transition-name: page-title on an element).

nodes.label: pagereveal event
nodes.rationale: Fires on the new page when a cross-document view transition begins; assign view-transition-names based on navigation context (navigation.activation?.from); register the listener early via blocking="render" scripts.

nodes.label: prefers-reduced-motion
nodes.rationale: Users who request reduced motion should have cross-document view transitions disabled (navigation: none).

nodes.label: @view-transition at-rule
nodes.rationale: Opt in for standard navigations (link clicks, form submissions, back/forward) via navigation: auto; typically guarded by prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference.

nodes.label: ::view-transition-old(root)
nodes.rationale: Customizes the exit animation of the outgoing page (slide out to the left; base 0.4s ease-in-out).

nodes.label: ::view-transition-new(root)
nodes.rationale: Customizes the entry animation of the incoming page (slide in from the right).

nodes.label: :active-view-transition-type()
nodes.rationale: Pseudo-selector applying per-type animations; types are set via @view-transition types or the pagereveal event.

nodes.label: types (view-transition types)
nodes.rationale: Specifies which transition types always occur on the page; matched by :active-view-transition-type() selectors (e.g., previous).

nodes.label: pagereveal event
nodes.rationale: Computes the transition type from navigation.activation and adds it to e.viewTransition.types; fallback for unsupported browsers is a standard instant navigation.

nodes.label: prefers-reduced-motion
nodes.rationale: Support: Chrome 111+, Firefox 144+ (Baseline 2025-10-14), Safari 18+; wrap @view-transition in @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference).

nodes.label: Invoker Commands API
nodes.rationale: Declarative way for buttons to trigger actions on target elements via commandfor/command attributes, reducing manual event listeners and decoupling the UI from implementation details.

nodes.label: commandfor attribute
nodes.rationale: Points the button at the target element's id in the same document tree; MANDATORY for commands to fire.

nodes.label: command attribute
nodes.rationale: Specifies the action name; custom commands MUST start with "--" to avoid collisions with future built-in commands.

nodes.label: command event (does not bubble)
nodes.rationale: Handle on the target element (or use {capture: true} on an ancestor); use event.composedPath()[0] instead of event.target inside shadow roots.

nodes.label: commandRegistry (optional)
nodes.rationale: Maps custom commands to handler functions for cleaner logic; dispatch via event.command.

nodes.label: aria-pressed (custom commands)
nodes.rationale: Custom commands have no inherent semantics; accessibility: set aria-pressed/aria-expanded states explicitly on the button.

nodes.label: Invoker Commands API
nodes.rationale: Declarative open/close control of <dialog> and [popover] elements from HTML buttons; removes boilerplate and provides focus management and accessibility bindings like aria-expanded.

nodes.label: toggle-popover command
nodes.rationale: Single button toggles popover open/closed (default for popovers).

nodes.label: show-popover command
nodes.rationale: Opens the popover; pair with hide-popover; use popover="manual" so separate buttons open/close.

nodes.label: hide-popover command
nodes.rationale: Explicitly closes a manual popover.

nodes.label: show-modal command
nodes.rationale: Opens <dialog> as a modal: traps focus and prevents interaction with the rest of the page.

nodes.label: close command
nodes.rationale: Safely dismisses the dialog; MUST set type="button" on command buttons inside <form method="dialog"> so the command runs rather than submitting.

nodes.label: popover attribute
nodes.rationale: Marks the element as a controlled popover; use popover="manual" for separate show/close buttons.

nodes.label: command event (does not bubble)
nodes.rationale: Handle on the target or on an ancestor with capture; the polyfill also handles custom commands natively.

nodes.label: invokers-polyfill
nodes.rationale: Conditionally loaded only when 'commandForElement' in HTMLButtonElement.prototype is false; feature-detect via that property; does not manage ARIA states.

nodes.label: @oddbird/popover-polyfill
nodes.rationale: Polyfills the popover attribute; feature-detect via 'popover' in HTMLElement.prototype; load only when missing; use setAttribute instead of the popover IDL property before the polyfill loads; style with :is(:popover-open, .\:popover-open).

nodes.label: document.startViewTransition({update, types})
nodes.rationale: SPA navigation via startViewTransition; the types array categorizes the transition and matches CSS :active-view-transition-type() selectors; feature-detect via !document.startViewTransition and run updateDOM() directly (fallback: standard instant navigation).

nodes.label: :active-view-transition-type()
nodes.rationale: Applies slide-to-left/slide-from-right (forward) and slide-to-right/slide-from-left (backward) animations based on the active transition type.

nodes.label: Slide keyframes
nodes.rationale: slide-to-left, slide-from-right, slide-to-right, slide-from-left; animate transform (performant); avoid non-performant properties.

nodes.label: ::view-transition-group(root)
nodes.rationale: Shared animation settings (0.4s ease-in-out); MUST use non-linear timing functions (ease/cubic-bezier) rather than linear.

nodes.label: Rearrange Items with Drag and Drop
Element.moveBefore()
nodes.rationale: Reorder the real children in the DOM (not CSS order or reverse) so visual, keyboard, and reading order stay aligned; preserves focus, scroll position, and iframe state.

nodes.label: Drop marker (data-drop)
nodes.rationale: Communicate where the drop will be: set data-drop on the list during a drag, draw the marker with ::before ring and ::after line (both position: fixed; pointer-events: none).

nodes.label: FLIP animation of moves
nodes.rationale: Animate every move: record sibling getBoundingClientRect() before the move, then animate translate from the old offset to 0; on release animate from the dragged position to the final rect.

nodes.label: Keyboard reordering
nodes.rationale: Alternatives: action buttons/menu (default discoverable), direct arrow keys on a focusable handle, or grab-move-drop mode (Space/Enter, arrow keys, Space/Enter drop, Escape cancel).

nodes.label: Dedicated drag handle
nodes.rationale: Use a dedicated handle when the element contains selectable text, buttons, inputs, or links; gives space for pointer-drag start; must be focusable with an accessible name mentioning the arrow-key interaction and expose role=button.

nodes.label: handle.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId)
nodes.rationale: Keeps the drag active after the pointer leaves the handle; clean up on lostpointercapture; start only for the primary button (event.button === 0).

nodes.label: Element.moveBefore()
nodes.rationale: Used to reparent dialog/popover/top-layer elements so they stay open (see persistent-top-layer-ui).

nodes.label: Arrow-key movement with preventDefault()
nodes.rationale: Move the element with arrow keys while the handle is focused; use the same clamped positioning helper as pointer movement.

nodes.label: visually-hidden aria-live region
nodes.rationale: Announce moves to screen readers ('[Name of element] moved [new position]'); include on page load; remove after a second.

nodes.label: sibling-index() CSS function
nodes.rationale: Returns the 1-based integer of an element's position among its siblings; multiply by time for animation-delay.

nodes.label: animation-delay: calc(sibling-index() * time)
nodes.rationale: Holds each sibling's initial keyframe during its stagger delay (animation: fade-in 0.4s both + animation-delay: calc(sibling-index() * var(--stagger-time))).

nodes.label: @supports (animation-delay: calc(sibling-index() * 0.1s))
nodes.rationale: MANDATORY gate in supporting browsers; test support with a literal time value because var() inside @supports/CSS.supports() always parses as true; do NOT put var() inside @supports.

nodes.label: Handling dynamic user-triggered changes to sort order
Element.moveBefore()
nodes.rationale: Reorder existing DOM nodes into the new order; do NOT recreate nodes (innerHTML/re-render discards focus, scroll, image state, and breaks view transitions which match elements by identity).

nodes.label: view-transition-name: match-element
nodes.rationale: Derives each element's unique transition name from its DOM node identity; used with element.startViewTransition().

nodes.label: role=status visually-hidden status element
nodes.rationale: Announce reorder once per action: set text once after the update; name the result (e.g., 'Sorted by price, low to high, 24 items') not the mechanism; do not put aria-live on the list; keep focus on the triggering control.

nodes.label: element.startViewTransition() scoped transitions
nodes.rationale: Prefer element.startViewTransition() over document.startViewTransition() for list updates.

nodes.label: Smoothly rearrange cards, lists, and groups of elements on add, remove, or reorder
view-transition-class
nodes.rationale: Shared class assigned to multiple elements with identical transition behavior; defined once in CSS instead of repeating view-transition-name.

nodes.label: ::view-transition-group(.class)
nodes.rationale: Targets any view transition group with the view-transition-class to apply shared animation styles.

nodes.label: :only-child entry/exit animations
nodes.rationale: Entry effects: ::view-transition-new(.list-item):only-child with slide-in and ease-out (added items); exit effects: ::view-transition-old(.list-item):only-child with slide-out and ease-in (removed items).

nodes.label: document.startViewTransition()
nodes.rationale: Wrap the DOM update; fallback: run updateDOM() immediately when unsupported.

nodes.label: CSS Custom Highlight API
nodes.rationale: Styles arbitrary text ranges without modifying the DOM structure (search-result highlighting, syntax coloring, collaborative editing cursors, spelling/grammar error markers).

nodes.label: TreeWalker (SHOW_TEXT)
nodes.rationale: Collect target text nodes via document.createTreeWalker(article, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT); cache and rebuild only when the DOM changes.

nodes.label: Range objects
nodes.rationale: Set range start/end on text nodes: range.setStart(textNode, matchStartIndex); range.setEnd(textNode, matchEndIndex).

nodes.label: CSS.highlights (HighlightRegistry)
nodes.rationale: Map-like registry; clear stale highlights with CSS.highlights.clear(); register with CSS.highlights.set('search-results', highlight); higher priority paints on top.

nodes.label: Highlight
nodes.rationale: Groups one or more Range objects sharing one style into a single Highlight.

nodes.label: ::highlight() pseudo-element
nodes.rationale: Styles each registered highlight by name.

nodes.label: Allowed highlight CSS properties
nodes.rationale: Only color, background-color, text-decoration(+longhands), text-shadow, -webkit-text-stroke(-color/-width), and -webkit-text-fill-color work; others like background-image, font-size, padding are ignored.

nodes.label: <mark> fallback
nodes.rationale: When CSS.highlights is missing, wrap matches in <mark> elements preserving structure; use textContent assignment to avoid HTML injection.

nodes.label: mask-image (radial-gradient)
nodes.rationale: Reveal via radial-gradient mask; the spotlight is the transparent center of the mask; use mask-repeat: no-repeat and pointer-events: none on the mask layer.

nodes.label: @property registered custom properties
nodes.rationale: Register --inner-size and --outer-size (syntax: <length-percentage>, inherits: true, initial-value: 0px) to enable smooth interpolation of gradient stops.

nodes.label: --mouse-x / --mouse-y (pointer position vars)
nodes.rationale: Track pointer position via pointermove; update the container rect on ResizeObserver; set the vars as percentages; position vars update immediately, size vars transition.

nodes.label: transition of registered size properties
nodes.rationale: Only transition the registered size properties; do NOT transition the position variables.

nodes.label: .container:hover expands --inner-size/--outer-size
nodes.rationale: Expands the spotlight on hover; .reveal-layer inherits the vars.

nodes.label: interestfor attribute
nodes.rationale: Declarative interest relationship between a source (button/link) and a target element; creates preview effects via interest/loseinterest events; a source has a single target, targets can have multiple sources.

nodes.label: interest / loseinterest events
nodes.rationale: Apply the preview on interest (event.target.dataset.preview = event.source.dataset.effect); unapply on loseinterest; InterestEvent has a source property.

nodes.label: :interest-source / :interest-target
nodes.rationale: CSS pseudo-selectors for active interest sources and targets.

nodes.label: popover="hint" popovers (tooltips/toggletips)
nodes.rationale: Creates tooltips; hides other popover="hint" tooltips but not auto/manual; provides light-dismiss and handles nested tooltip dismissal.

nodes.label: Tooltip vs Toggletip vs Inline content
nodes.rationale: Tooltip: short clarification of a control (missing costs little). Toggletip: info users may want but most don't need every time; needs an explicit visible affordance. Inline content: info users need while acting.

nodes.label: role="tooltip" on hint (toggletip)
nodes.rationale: Trigger gets aria-expanded + aria-details while open; the open hint comes right after the trigger in tab order.

nodes.label: role="tooltip" + aria-describedby (non-activation trigger)
nodes.rationale: For links/action buttons that do something else on activation; never aria-expanded; the description must be something the user can afford to miss.

nodes.label: aria-labelledby for icon-only triggers
nodes.rationale: When the trigger has no visible name, aria-labelledby on the trigger pointing at the hint.

nodes.label: aria-expanded synced from popover toggle event
nodes.rationale: Source of truth is the popover; sync from the popover's toggle event with a capturing listener on document (toggle does not bubble); polyfill does not sync aria-expanded when toggletips are opened via popovertarget.

nodes.label: No aria-haspopup or live region on hints
nodes.rationale: Both are prohibited on tooltips.

nodes.label: Don't override author ARIA on triggers
nodes.rationale: Existing aria-describedby, aria-labelledby, or aria-expanded on the trigger wins.

nodes.label: WCAG 1.4.13 (Content on Hover or Focus)
nodes.rationale: MUST satisfy: Dismissible (Escape), Hoverable (pointer can move over the tooltip), Persistent (until trigger removed, dismissed, or content invalid).

nodes.label: Implicit CSS Anchor Positioning
nodes.rationale: Opened via interestfor, the trigger is an implicit anchor for the popover; use position-area: block-start + position-try-fallbacks: flip-block + inset: auto; margin: 0.

nodes.label: @oddbird/css-anchor-positioning polyfill
nodes.rationale: Feature-detect via CSS.supports('anchor-name: --a'); load only when missing; no implicit anchors (explicit anchor-name/position-anchor required); do not wrap polyfilled rules in @supports; use anchor() on inset props for position-area workarounds.

nodes.label: closedby attribute
nodes.rationale: Declarative light-dismiss: values any (backdrop clicks + close requests + dev mechanisms), closerequest (default for modal), none (dev only); non-modal dialogs don't have a backdrop.

nodes.label: dialog.showModal()
nodes.rationale: Opens in the top layer with focus trapping; use for modal behavior (Esc close requests and platform back gestures handled natively).

nodes.label: dialog::backdrop pseudo-element
nodes.rationale: Modal dialogs have a backdrop covering the viewport; clicks on the backdrop (event.target === dialog) dismiss when closedby="any".

nodes.label: closedby fallback script (browsers without closedBy support)
nodes.rationale: On dialog click: ignore if event.target !== dialog; check the click against getBoundingClientRect(); if outside the content box, call dialog.close().

nodes.label: clip-path / mask-image
nodes.rationale: Custom geometric reveals and smooth fade-outs; both clip the element's own focus outline, so draw focus on an unclipped parent for focusable clipped elements.

nodes.label: Scroll-Driven Animations (animation-timeline: scroll())
nodes.rationale: Non-essential scroll-bound effects instead of JS listeners.

nodes.label: View Transitions
nodes.rationale: Animate between complex layout states (cross-document and same-document transitions).

nodes.label: Prefer opacity and transform (incl. translate, scale, rotate)
nodes.rationale: Stay on the compositor thread; prefer individual transform properties.

nodes.label: transition-behavior: allow-discrete
nodes.rationale: Animate discrete entry/exit (display, overlay) natively; pair with @starting-style and overlay.

nodes.label: @starting-style
nodes.rationale: For discrete entry animations with transition-behavior: allow-discrete.

nodes.label: overlay (top-layer entry/exit)
nodes.rationale: For discrete entry/exit of top-layer elements (dialog, popover).

nodes.label: prefers-reduced-motion
nodes.rationale: Strategy choice: no-preference = don't have animation at all (opt in); reduce = change parameters; do not globally apply animation-duration: 0.01ms; don't put flashing content inside no-preference; keep non-motion transitions (color/background-color) enabled.

nodes.label: Pause, Stop, Hide (WCAG 2.2.2)
nodes.rationale: Moving content >5s needs a visible pause/stop/hide control; don't toggle aria-pressed when the label changes between Pause and Play.

nodes.label: Flash limit (WCAG 2.3.1)
nodes.rationale: No rapid light-to-dark flashing; nothing flashes >3 times in any 1s period, even with reduced motion.

nodes.label: Move DOM Element Without Losing State
Element.moveBefore()
nodes.rationale: Atomic move, bypasses remove+insert so <iframe> reloads, animations, and focus are preserved; same signature as insertBefore.

nodes.label: connectedMoveCallback()
nodes.rationale: When moving via moveBefore(), connectedCallback/disconnectedCallback do NOT fire; implement connectedMoveCallback() for location-dependent logic.

nodes.label: Fallback: insertBefore/appendChild
nodes.rationale: Older browsers: traditional move resets iframe/animation/focus state; re-establish state manually.

nodes.label: Build a Parallax Effect on Scroll
view-timeline (wrapper)
nodes.rationale: Declare view timeline on the wrapper: view-timeline: --wrapper; layers link via animation-timeline: --wrapper.

nodes.label: Scroll-Driven Animations (CSS Scroll-Timeline)
nodes.rationale: Use CSS scroll-driven animations for parallax; feature-detect: @supports ((animation-timeline: view()) and (animation-range: entry)); do NOT use scroll-timeline-polyfill.

nodes.label: animation-range stagger (sibling-index/sibling-count)
nodes.rationale: animation-range: entry 25% exit calc(100% / sibling-count() * sibling-index()).

nodes.label: Declare animation-timeline/animation-range AFTER the animation shorthand
nodes.rationale: The animation shorthand resets timeline and range.

nodes.label: prefers-reduced-motion
nodes.rationale: animation: none on layers.

nodes.label: Element.moveBefore()
nodes.rationale: Reparent dialog/popover/fullscreen elements atomically so their open state persists during moves.

nodes.label: Fullscreen elements
nodes.rationale: moveBefore also preserves fullscreen state.

nodes.label: linear() timing function
nodes.rationale: Series of stops approximating complex curves (springs, bounces); apply to transition/animation timing functions.

nodes.label: Spring easing (--spring-easing)
nodes.rationale: Overshoots the target before settling; example --spring-easing linear(0, 0.016 0.5%, ..., 1); apply with transition: scale 0.8s var(--spring-easing).

nodes.label: Bounce easing (--bounce-easing)
nodes.rationale: --bounce-easing linear(0, 0.214 14.7%, ..., 1); avoid on opacity (can flicker below 0 or above 1).

nodes.label: Always include duration for linear()
nodes.rationale: linear() doesn't calculate duration automatically; MANDATORY: duration must be included.

nodes.label: Apply linear() to compositor-thread properties (transform, opacity)
nodes.rationale: Smoothest physics effects.

nodes.label: Close requests (Esc, mobile back gesture)
nodes.rationale: Users expect Esc on desktop and back button/gesture on mobile to dismiss modal dialogs; handled natively when the dialog is in modal state (showModal() or show-modal command).

nodes.label: Esc key
nodes.rationale: Handles close requests on desktop keyboards.

nodes.label: Back button/gesture on mobile
nodes.rationale: Handled natively by close requests for modal dialogs opened in modal state.

nodes.label: showModal() / show-modal command
nodes.rationale: Required for modal state; non-modal dialogs (show()) lack the native handling.

nodes.label: Prevent the Page Underneath a Modal Dialog from Scrolling
overscroll-behavior: contain
nodes.rationale: Applies to all scroll containers (including non-scrollable ones); pure CSS containment of scroll chaining when combined with overflow: hidden on the dialog and backdrop.

nodes.label: dialog:modal { overscroll-behavior: contain }
nodes.rationale: MANDATORY on dialog:modal (or dialog) — even when content doesn't overflow — so gestures inside the dialog don't chain to the page.

nodes.label: dialog::backdrop { overflow: hidden }
nodes.rationale: MANDATORY: ::backdrop defaults to overflow: visible (not a scroll container); setting overflow: hidden makes it a non-scrollable scroll container that honors overscroll-behavior.

nodes.label: dialog::backdrop { overscroll-behavior: contain }
nodes.rationale: MANDATORY; traps gestures over the backdrop so they don't scroll the page.

nodes.label: showModal() marks the background document inert
nodes.rationale: Blocks pointer clicks and keyboard focus on the background page but does NOT prevent scrolling — hence this guide.

nodes.label: document.startViewTransition()
nodes.rationale: Wrap state changes in SPA; captures the snapshot, runs the update, captures the new state; pairs morph by view-transition-name; transition happens in the top layer above high z-index.

nodes.label: view-transition-name (unique per element)
nodes.rationale: MANDATORY: no more than 1 element before and after with a given name (else no transition); assign via CSS or dynamically.

nodes.label: Dynamic view-transition-names for SPA list/detail
nodes.rationale: Strategy A (dynamic detail): unique names on list items + dynamically apply the matching name to the detail-page hero element. Strategy B (dynamic list item): apply the name to the list thumbnail when selected, remove when returning.

nodes.label: transition.finished.finally() cleanup
nodes.rationale: Remove temporary view-transition-names after the transition; route focus to the updated heading or view container.

nodes.label: Programmatic focus routing
nodes.rationale: MANDATORY: move focus after the DOM update or when transition.finished resolves; use tabindex=-1 + focus({preventScroll: true}) where focus is on hidden/removed elements.

nodes.label: element.startViewTransition()
nodes.rationale: Scope a transition to a component subtree; the ::view-transition tree is injected on the element; only the subtree is captured; multiple components transition concurrently; external stacking contexts preserved (document.startViewTransition blocks page interaction and obscures popovers).

nodes.label: view-transition-name: match-element
nodes.rationale: Derives unique names from DOM node identity for dynamic list items; names isolated per scope.

nodes.label: view-transition-scope: all
nodes.rationale: Active scopes get UA view-transition-scope: all so internal names don't leak into outer transitions; apply on repeated component containers.

nodes.label: Nested View Transition Groups
nodes.rationale: view-transition-group: contain + ::view-transition-group-children(.class) overflow: clip when a captured element inside the scope clips its own overflow and contains nested captured elements.

nodes.label: transition.ready.catch(() => {})
nodes.rationale: Re-triggering element.startViewTransition() on the same scope skips the active transition and rejects ready; catch to avoid unhandled rejections.

nodes.label: Wrapper element for outer transitions
nodes.rationale: When an outer transition moves a component during an inner transition: wrap the inner scope in a separate wrapper with view-transition-name; apply view-transition-scope: all to the inner scope.

nodes.label: Triggering Effects After Programmatic Scrolling Completes
Scroll method promises (scrollIntoView, scrollTo, scrollBy, scroll)
nodes.rationale: Programmatic scroll methods return a Promise resolving when the scroll completes; resolves immediately if the target is already in view (no scrolling).

nodes.label: await scroll methods (MANDATORY)
nodes.rationale: Mark handler async; await element.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth'}); apply post-scroll effects (highlight, animation, focus) after the await.

nodes.label: focus({preventScroll: true})
nodes.rationale: When focusing after a scroll, pass {preventScroll: true} so the focus call doesn't initiate a second, competing scroll.

nodes.label: Scroll request token (interrupted scrolls)
nodes.rationale: New smooth scrolls abort/resolve pending ones on the container; track an incrementing token and return early if a newer scroll was started; do NOT rely on rejection.
